analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold territory but remains in neutral. MACD histogram shows improvement, but a trend reversal is not yet confirmed. ADX at 38.3 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is above +DI, suggesting stronger downward pressure. The $5.20 support near the 52-week low is crucial, with the $8.37 resistance being the key level to watch. Trading volume at 0.65x the 5-day average is subdued, indicating a period of directional exploration.
